Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/src/sql/testscripts/queries/select:
     1	# Tests the SELECT part of queries.
     2	
     3	# Create a basic test table, and a secondary table for join column lookups.
     4	> CREATE TABLE test ( \
     5	    id INT PRIMARY KEY, \
     6	    "bool" BOOLEAN, \
     7	    "float" FLOAT, \
     8	    "int" INT, \
     9	    "string" STRING \
    10	)
    11	> INSERT INTO test VALUES (1, true, 3.14, 7, 'foo')
    12	> INSERT INTO test VALUES (2, false, 2.718, 1, '👍')
    13	> INSERT INTO test VALUES (3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
    14	
    15	> CREATE TABLE other (id INT PRIMARY KEY, value STRING)
    16	> INSERT INTO other VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')
    17	---
    18	ok
    19	
    20	# Select constant values.
    21	[plan]> select 1
    22	---
    23	Projection: 1
    24	└─ Values: blank row
    25	1
    26	
    27	[plan]> SELECT NULL, NOT FALSE, 2^2+1, 3.14*2, 'Hi 👋'
    28	---
    29	Projection: NULL, TRUE, 5, 6.28, 'Hi 👋'
    30	└─ Values: blank row
    31	NULL, TRUE, 5, 6.28, 'Hi 👋'
    32	
    33	# Bare select errors, as does trailing comma and identifier without a table.
    34	!> SELECT
    35	!> SELECT 1,
    36	!> SELECT foo
    37	---
    38	Error: invalid input: unexpected end of input
    39	Error: invalid input: unexpected end of input
    40	Error: invalid input: expression must be constant, found column foo
    41	
    42	# Select from a table.
    43	[plan,header]> SELECT * FROM test
    44	---
    45	Scan: test
    46	test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string
    47	1, TRUE, 3.14, 7, 'foo'
    48	2, FALSE, 2.718, 1, '👍'
    49	3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
    50	
    51	[plan,header]> SELECT "bool" FROM test
    52	---
    53	Projection: test.bool
    54	└─ Scan: test
    55	test.bool
    56	TRUE
    57	FALSE
    58	NULL
    59	
    60	# * can't be used with table names, for simplicity.
    61	!> SELECT test.* FROM test
    62	---
    63	Error: invalid input: expected identifier, got *
    64	
    65	# A SELECT * without a table errors, as does a bare FROM.
    66	!> SELECT *
    67	!> SELECT * FROM
    68	---
    69	Error: invalid input: SELECT * requires a FROM clause
    70	Error: invalid input: unexpected end of input
    71	
    72	# A * errors in expressions. For simplicity, expressions only support scalars.
    73	!> SELECT 1 + * FROM test
    74	!> SELECT sqrt(*) FROM test
    75	!> SELECT max(*) FROM test
    76	---
    77	Error: invalid input: unsupported use of *
    78	Error: invalid input: unsupported use of *
    79	Error: invalid input: unsupported use of *
    80	
    81	# A * can be used multiple times.
    82	[plan,header]> SELECT *, *, * FROM test
    83	---
    84	Projection: test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string, test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string, test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string
    85	└─ Scan: test
    86	test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string, test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string, test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string
    87	1, TRUE, 3.14, 7, 'foo', 1, TRUE, 3.14, 7, 'foo', 1, TRUE, 3.14, 7, 'foo'
    88	2, FALSE, 2.718, 1, '👍', 2, FALSE, 2.718, 1, '👍', 2, FALSE, 2.718, 1, '👍'
    89	3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
    90	
    91	# Mix *, columns, column expressions, and constant expressions.
    92	[plan,header]> SELECT id, 7-4, *, "float"^2 FROM test
    93	---
    94	Projection: test.id, 3, test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string, test.float ^ 2
    95	└─ Scan: test
    96	test.id, , test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string, 
    97	1, 3, 1, TRUE, 3.14, 7, 'foo', 9.8596
    98	2, 3, 2, FALSE, 2.718, 1, '👍', 7.387524
    99	3, 3, 3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
   100	
   101	# Column names may be qualified or unqualified.
   102	[header]> SELECT id, test."bool" FROM test
   103	---
   104	test.id, test.bool
   105	1, TRUE
   106	2, FALSE
   107	3, NULL
   108	
   109	# The table may be aliased, and qualified using the alias. The AS alias keyword
   110	# is optional.
   111	[header,plan]> SELECT id, t."bool" FROM test AS t
   112	---
   113	Projection: t.id, t.bool
   114	└─ Scan: test as t
   115	t.id, t.bool
   116	1, TRUE
   117	2, FALSE
   118	3, NULL
   119	
   120	[header]> SELECT id, t."bool" FROM test t
   121	---
   122	t.id, t.bool
   123	1, TRUE
   124	2, FALSE
   125	3, NULL
   126	
   127	# Unknown tables or columns error. Including the original table when aliased.
   128	!> SELECT * FROM unknown
   129	!> SELECT unknown FROM test
   130	!> SELECT test.unknown FROM test
   131	!> SELECT test.id.unknown FROM test
   132	!> SELECT unknown.id FROM test
   133	!> SELECT test.id FROM test AS t
   134	---
   135	Error: invalid input: table unknown does not exist
   136	Error: invalid input: unknown column unknown
   137	Error: invalid input: unknown column test.unknown
   138	Error: invalid input: unexpected token .
   139	Error: invalid input: unknown table unknown
   140	Error: invalid input: unknown table test
   141	
   142	# Columns, both constant and from tables, can be aliased.
   143	# The AS keyword is optional.
   144	[header,plan]> SELECT 1 AS one, test."int" value FROM test
   145	---
   146	Projection: 1 as one, test.int as value
   147	└─ Scan: test
   148	one, value
   149	1, 7
   150	1, 1
   151	1, NULL
   152	
   153	# Aliases can have special characters and keywords if quoted.
   154	[header]> SELECT 1 AS "integer", 2 AS "hi 👋"
   155	---
   156	integer, hi 👋
   157	1, 2
   158	
   159	# Expressions can't reference aliases.
   160	!> SELECT 1 AS one, one + 1
   161	!> SELECT id AS alias, alias + 1 FROM test
   162	---
   163	Error: invalid input: expression must be constant, found column one
   164	Error: invalid input: unknown column alias
   165	
   166	# Aliases can have the same name as table columns, but won't shadow them.
   167	[header]> SELECT 'foo' AS id, id, id + 3 FROM test
   168	---
   169	id, test.id, 
   170	'foo', 1, 4
   171	'foo', 2, 5
   172	'foo', 3, 6
   173	
   174	# Multiple aliases can have the same name.
   175	[header]> SELECT 1 AS id, id, "float" AS id FROM test
   176	---
   177	id, test.id, id
   178	1, 1, 3.14
   179	1, 2, 2.718
   180	1, 3, NULL
   181	
   182	# Aliases can't be qualified.
   183	!> SELECT 1 AS foo.bar
   184	---
   185	Error: invalid input: unexpected token .
   186	
   187	# Bare and * aliases error.
   188	!> SELECT 1 AS
   189	!> SELECT * AS all FROM test
   190	---
   191	Error: invalid input: unexpected end of input
   192	Error: invalid input: can't alias *
   193	
   194	# Ambiguous columns error.
   195	!> SELECT id FROM test, other
   196	---
   197	Error: invalid input: ambiguous column id
   198	
   199	# Unambiguous columns don't, resulting in a cross join.
   200	> SELECT "bool", value FROM test, other
   201	---
   202	TRUE, 'a'
   203	TRUE, 'b'
   204	FALSE, 'a'
   205	FALSE, 'b'
   206	NULL, 'a'
   207	NULL, 'b'
   208	
   209	# Qualified columns work, also when aliased.
   210	> SELECT test.id, other.id FROM test, other
   211	---
   212	1, 1
   213	1, 2
   214	2, 1
   215	2, 2
   216	3, 1
   217	3, 2
   218	
   219	> SELECT t.id, o.id FROM test t, other o
   220	---
   221	1, 1
   222	1, 2
   223	2, 1
   224	2, 2
   225	3, 1
   226	3, 2
   227	
   228	# A select with no rows optimized to a Nothing node still emits headers.
   229	[plan,header]> SELECT * FROM test WHERE FALSE
   230	---
   231	Nothing
   232	test.id, test.bool, test.float, test.int, test.string
   233
